FluxScope

Recovers how assets and positions move through a DeFi system (asset flows, holdings, claims, dependencies and exit paths) from Solidity code with static analysis, rules and an optional language model, and shows the result next to the source, with the evidence behind every statement.

How to read a report (works offline in the browser; nothing is installed or sent anywhere):
  • It opens in the Code view: the source on the left, a system map of contracts and users on the right.
  • Pick a function in the list: the graph shows only that function (caller, assets moved, calls; + opens the next level), and the source is annotated with what the analysis read from each line.
  • Hover a marked line to find it in the graph, or a graph item to find its lines; pin functions to build the picture up (in the Kaia report: redeem, pin, then claim — the two-step withdrawal).
  • The tabs Flows · Holdings · Dependencies · Exits · All show the whole system; Holdings answers who holds a share, what it claims and how to exit.

Real projects (pinned commits)

Kaia yield aggregator (partial snapshot)

Development project for ledgers, debts and registries: two-step withdrawals, strategy debt, a Yearn V2 vault and an ERC-4626 vault with registered strategies.

Kaia-side vault stack of a yield aggregator: CooldownVault (two-step-withdrawal wrapper of the underlying, 1:1 shares, strategy predeposit debt) feeding a Yearn V2 vault whose CustomYearnStrategy deposits the underlying into CustomVault (ERC-4626), which allocates to registered CustomStrategy contracts. Partial snapshot (the local yield path only) pinned to a fixed commit; the Yearn V2 vault (Vyper), the router, health checks, external-assets providers and execution targets are outside the analysed scope.

Beefy Vault V7 + StrategyERC4626

Development project of the first milestone: vault, strategy and an external ERC-4626 vault.

Beefy yield vault (BeefyVaultV7) whose strategy (StrategyERC4626) deploys the vault's want token into an external ERC-4626 vault. Snapshot of beefy-contracts pinned to a fixed commit; the external ERC-4626 vault, swapper, fee config, factory and Merkl claimer are outside the analysed scope.

MetaMorpho vault (Morpho Blue allocator)

Held-out project: analysed without analyzer changes. Morpho Blue itself is outside the scope (interface only), which the system map shows as a boundary.

MetaMorpho: an ERC-4626 vault that supplies its asset to Morpho Blue lending markets in a curated supply queue and withdraws through a withdraw queue; fees are minted as shares. Held-out case: analysed without analyzer changes. Morpho Blue itself is outside the analysed scope (interface only).
